## setting
**112 run(s)** — rule `afl20-setting` — 10.3389/fmicb.2020.00853  
*Materials and Methods, 'Growth and Inoculation of Maize'; corroborated by the GEO GSE101899 growth protocol*

> The maize inbred line B73 was grown IN THE FIELD in Clayton, NC at the Central Crops Research Station at North Carolina State University, during the years 2011 and 2013. Both years were planted on April and grown according to standard practices. Ears were hand pollinated on July 5-8 and COVERED WITH A PAPER BAG. A. flavus NRRL 3357 was grown on potato dextrose agar... In July, a time course study was performed by PIN BAR INOCULATING one ear (per time point) from eight maize B73 with A. flavus NR3357, and harvesting at 0, 6, 12, 18, 24, 30, 36, 42, 48, 72, 96, 120, and 140 h post inoculation. | GEO growth protocol, all 112 samples: 'B73 was hand planted in Clayton NC. At about 20 days after pollination, husks were pulled back and kernels were pin bar inoculated with 3357. Husks were placed back over the ear, secured with a rubber band, bagged and the bag was stapled around the stalk.' | greenhouse, glasshouse and growth chamber do not appear in the paper.
